def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def dbg(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in sorted(components(g), key=lambda c: max(r for r,_ in c), reverse=True):
        cs=set(comp)
        vals=[(r0,c,g[r0][c]) for r0,c in comp]
        print("comp",comp)
        while True:
            d=min(next((r-r0-1 for r in range(r0+1,h) if g[r][c] and (r,c) not in cs), h-1-r0) for r0,c in comp)
            print("  d",d)
            if d==0: break
            for r0,c,_ in vals: g[r0][c]=0
            for r0,c,v in vals: g[r0+d][c]=v
            comp=[(r0+d,c) for r0,c in comp]; cs=set(comp)
            vals=[(r0,c,g[r0][c]) for r0,c in comp]
    return g

def gravity(g, sign=1):
    """Connected components fall (sign=1: down, -1: up) as rigid shapes, bottom-most first, packing against the edge or each other; full one-color nonzero rows stay fixed as barriers."""
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    barriers={i for i,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0}
    fixed={i:g[i][:] for i in barriers}
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if i not in barriers]
    sub=[g[i][:] for i in rows]
    sh=len(sub)
    for comp in sorted(components(sub), key=lambda c: max(r for r,_ in c)*sign, reverse=True):
        cs=set(comp)
        while True:
            if sign==1:
                d=min(next((r-r0-1 for r in range(r0+1,sh) if sub[r][c] and (r,c) not in cs), sh-1-r0) for r0,c in comp)
            else:
                d=min(next((r0-r-1 for r in range(r0-1,-1,-1) if sub[r][c] and (r,c) not in cs), r0) for r0,c in comp)
            if d==0: break
            vals=[(r0,c,sub[r0][c]) for r0,c in comp]
            for r0,c,_ in vals: sub[r0][c]=0
            for r0,c,v in vals: sub[r0+sign*d][c]=v
            comp=[(r0+sign*d,c) for r0,c in comp]; cs=set(comp)
    out=[None]*h
    for k,i in enumerate(rows): out[i]=sub[k]
    for i,row in fixed.items(): out[i]=row
    return out
